title: IndicRecipeNutri
description:
A corpus of 224,002 Indian recipes with multilingual provenance and estimated dish-level micronutrition; a typed, IFCT-grounded knowledge graph of 227,499 nodes and 6,169,926 edges across 17 node types and 20 relation types; a 66-query retrieval benchmark with knowledge-graph-derived gold sets; and a synthetic collaborative interaction log.

Two-tier release. Structured, factual and derived fields are published under CC BY 4.0 with per-recipe source attribution. Raw recipe prose is not redistributed; a rehydration index of source URLs and SHA-256 text digests is published instead, together with a re-fetch script.

Known defects are published, not hidden. An independent allergen and diet audit ships with the data. See the datasheet before use, and do not use the allergen flags for end-user safety decisions.
notes: Corpus build v11. Recipe prose is withheld under the two-tier release model; see docs/DATASHEET.md.
